clips.send: A parent sends it to whoever still has baby powder in the house - the $10 billion lawsuit, and the fear of what else is sitting in the bathroom cabinet.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's Kevin-Was-Right file: Johnson & Johnson filed for bankruptcy to advance a $10 billion settlement over its talc-based baby powder.

The product is already off the market. His point: it hasn't been formally banned by the FDA - it was pulled before that had to happen, after decades of lawsuits over what the talc was doing once it got onto someone's skin.

His view on the agencies that oversee products like this: plenty of people there are doing the job right, and some aren't - which is exactly why he says check the label yourself before you trust it.

Do you know what's actually in the powder or lotion in your own bathroom cabinet?
